pages.title: Ancient Relics
pages.text: $(egyptian)Artifacts$() are powerful relics discovered in tombs and ruins. Each holds unique magical properties that can aid or harm.$(br2)$(warning)Handle with care.$() Some artifacts carry curses.

pages.title: Eye of Apophis
pages.text: The malevolent gaze of the chaos serpent. A $(curse)dangerous artifact$() that channels dark power.

pages.title: Canopic Heart Jar
pages.text: Sacred vessel containing preserved organs. Essential for certain rituals and crafting recipes.

pages.title: Eternal Sigil
pages.text: Divine artifact that removes all status effects and grants Regeneration II, Fire Resistance, and Resistance. A one-time use artifact perfect for emergency curse removal.

pages.title: The Eye of Apophis
pages.text: Though dangerous, the $(item)Eye of Apophis$() is required to activate the $(gold)Solar Spire$(). Use it to click the pyramidion and unleash Ra's purifying power across the land.
